The following events took place in '''719 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This [[Standard year/Legends|year]] was known as '''Year 684''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]] and '''Year 281''' after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

==Events==
*c.719 BBY - The [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Royal Palace]] is built in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="RoDV" />
